title: How do I reset my password?
content: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and enter your account email. We send a reset link that stays valid for 30 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder. Support can also trigger the reset email for you.

title: My account is locked after failed login attempts
content: Accounts lock for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts. Wait and try again, or reset your password to unlock the account immediately.

title: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
content: Go to Settings, then Security, then Two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code to confirm. Save your backup codes somewhere safe.

title: I did not receive my verification code
content: Codes arrive within 2 minutes and expire after 10 minutes. Check your spam folder, confirm the email address or phone number on your profile, then request a new code.

title: Why was I charged twice?
content: A second charge is usually a temporary authorization hold that drops off within 3 to 5 business days. If both charges have settled, reply with the last 4 digits of the card and the dates, and we will refund the duplicate.

title: Where can I download my invoice or receipt?
content: Open Settings, then Billing, then Invoices. Every invoice has a PDF download button. Invoices are created on the billing date.

title: How do I change my payment method or card?
content: Go to Settings, then Billing, then Payment methods. Add the new card and mark it as default. The change applies from the next billing cycle.

title: How do I cancel my subscription?
content: Go to Settings, then Billing, then Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the paid period. Refunds for the current period are only available within 14 days of purchase.

title: When does my subscription renew?
content: Subscriptions renew automatically on the same date every period. A reminder email is sent 7 days before renewal. You can see the exact date under Settings, then Billing.

title: What is the return policy?
content: Unused items in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Start from Orders, then Return item. A prepaid return label is emailed to you immediately.

title: How long does a refund take?
content: Refunds are posted to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned item or approve the request. Your bank may need extra time to show it.

title: I received a damaged, defective or wrong item
content: We are sorry about that. Reply with your order number and a photo of the item. We will ship a free replacement or issue a full refund within 2 business days.

title: How do I exchange an item for another size or color?
content: Start a return from Orders, choose Exchange, and pick the new size or color. Shipping is free in both directions and the replacement ships when the return is scanned.

title: Where is my order? How do I track my package?
content: Track your package from Orders, then Track package, or use the link in your shipping confirmation email. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update after dispatch.

title: How long does delivery take?
content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days and express takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed before 2 pm dispatch the same day.

title: My package says delivered but I have not received it
content: Carrier scans can be a day early. Check around the property and with neighbours, and wait 24 hours. If it still has not arrived, reply with your order number and we will open a carrier investigation.

title: Can I change the shipping address after ordering?
content: You can edit the address within 1 hour of ordering from Orders, then Edit address. After dispatch the address cannot be changed, but you can redirect through the carrier tracking page.

title: The app keeps crashing or freezing
content: Update to the latest app version and restart your device. Then clear the cache under Settings, Apps, Storage. If it still crashes, reinstall the app and sign in again.

title: A page will not load or shows an error
content: Do a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R), clear your browser cache, and try another browser or disable extensions. Check the status page for ongoing incidents.

title: I am not getting notifications
content: Confirm notifications are enabled under Settings, then Notifications, and that your phone allows them for the app. Make sure Do Not Disturb is off.

title: The API returns 401 unauthorized or an error
content: Check that your API key is active under Developer, then API keys, and that it is sent in the Authorization: Bearer header. Keys expire after 90 days and must be rotated.

title: How do I update my email address?
content: Go to Settings, then Profile, then Email. Enter the new address and confirm it with the verification link we send there. Support can also process the change for you.

title: How do I change my phone number, name or address?
content: Open Settings, then Profile, edit the field you need and save. Changes show up immediately.

title: How do I delete my account?
content: Account deletion is permanent and handled by our privacy team after an identity check. Deleted data cannot be restored.

title: What are your support hours?
content: Chat and email support are available 24/7. Phone support runs Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm IST.

title: How do I talk to a human agent?
content: Reply to this ticket and ask for a person, or call during phone hours. Complex or sensitive tickets are handed to a human automatically with the full context.
